title: Unequal Impact of Zestimate on the Housing Market
authors: Runshan Fu; Yan Hua Huang; Nitin Mehta; Param Vir Singh; Kannan Srinivasan
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional listing-level regressions of log listing/sold price, time on market (nbreg) and price changes (logit) on Zestimate deviation and Zestimate range with neighborhood FE and home facts, plus a structural Bayesian-learning model of sellers and buyers. No adoption timing, no DiD; key variables in the shipped data are synthetic.
design_notes: reduced_form.do: reg log_listing zestdev log_upd_zest i.farea $homefacts; nbreg tom ...; logit price_change ...; interaction with listing_zest_range_log. Structural model in est_main.m, counterfactuals counter1/2_main.m.
data_files_note: Real home facts and masked neighborhoods; listing price, sold price, Zestimate and time on market are synthetic.
data_provenance_note: README: synthetic data for listing price, sold price, Zestimate and time on market; real data for other variables. Moot (no DiD).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
